g.text: One token through the V4.1-Flash router (reference inference code)
(text bias or image bias, per token)
sum of 6 weighted routed outputs + shared output -> back into the residual stream
Bias update (training only): after each step, b_i += u * sign(mean load - load_i), u = 0.001; the two modality biases update against their own loads.
The bias never touches the mixing weights, so no gradient interference (Wang et al. 2024).
